title: Build a YouTube plan that drives Skool and paid AI app demand
purpose: Verify that YouTube strategy connects topics to buyer pain, community conversion, and paid offers.
prompt: Create a 30-day YouTube growth plan for becoming the leading Polish AI community while validating paid business app niches.
expected_behaviors: Starts from paid buyer pains, not generic AI news.
Includes title, hook, thumbnail brief, CTA, and repurposing path.
Connects videos to Skool, email capture, and a paid offer.
Defines analytics beyond views, including retention and lead conversion.
States what should not be automated yet.
failure_patterns: Optimizes for subscribers without revenue path.
judge_notes: Passing output must include one video-to-paid-offer funnel.
